page.overview:
Who is Bramble?

Bramble was a fairy barbarian and a member of the Glorious Ones, a small group of adventurers. She was played by Laura Bailey in .

Bramble is a small but muscular fairy woman with light green skin adorned with darker spots in her arms and cheeks (as well as some scars), a mane of yellow-orange hair (which turns fiery red when she rages), and four insect-like green wings (which glow when she rages). Her appearance is somewhat dirty, and her attire consists of a combination of thorns, sticks, dry leaves, dead flowers, and animal hair.

Bramble is intense, determined and daring.

At some point before 795 PD Bramble met Ranthiel Volthor, a warlock with whom she became intimately involved, but who did not seem as interested in having a relationship as she was.
